_comment: Code registry for conformance/session/v1 (POST /sessions/{principal}/{epoch}/renew and /evidence), under the error envelope of ADR bh-hq-pio.5: every non-2xx body is {"error":{"code","message","retryable","requestId","details"}}. Each entry: the HTTP status, retryable, and the message clients see in error.message; an optional note is authoring commentary and is never served. A code heartbeat/v1 also uses carries heartbeat/v1's Python message; every other code is normative and its message says what it means. 409 for every rule refusal; 400/413/415/401 for a call that never reaches a rule; 503 retryable for transient failure; 409 retryable for a CAS conflict. Owned by the corpus, not either implementation. Every code listed here is expected by a case; the codes only the HTTP layer emits are in conformance/http/v1/codes.json.

no_current_grant.message: principal has no current operator-granted incarnation

beat_not_fresh.message: heartbeat first observation expired or future-skewed

floor_unprovisioned.message: protected observer floor was not provisioned

identity_mismatch.message: the identity differs from the protected grant
identity_mismatch.note: normative (no Python reference); endpoint-neutral wording for a code several endpoints share, served in error.message; the per-endpoint registries keep Python's wording for their corpora

request_not_canonical.message: the request payload is not canonical
request_not_canonical.note: normative (no Python reference); endpoint-neutral wording for a code several endpoints share, served in error.message; the per-endpoint registries keep Python's wording for their corpora

request_size_invalid.note: HTTP 413 here; Python reports this as a refusal; normative (no Python reference); endpoint-neutral wording for a code several endpoints share, served in error.message; the per-endpoint registries keep Python's wording for their corpora

path_principal_mismatch.message: the attested principal is not the principal in the path
path_principal_mismatch.note: normative (no Python reference); checked before any lookup, so it never reveals whether the path principal exists

epoch_stale.message: the path epoch is below the principal's committed epoch

epoch_future.message: the path epoch is above the principal's committed epoch

path_invalid.message: a path segment is not in canonical form
path_invalid.note: normative (no Python reference); the epoch is a non-negative decimal integer without leading zeros

beat_signature_invalid.message: the beat is not signed by the granted key
beat_signature_invalid.note: normative (no Python reference); Python folds this into authority_failed

beat_schema_invalid.message: the signed beat violates the FrameLease schema, including unknown fields and seq below 1
beat_schema_invalid.note: normative (no Python reference); Python folds this into authority_failed

request_malformed.message: the body is not one JSON document

upstream_authentication_failed.message: the gateway attestation is missing, invalid or for another scope
upstream_authentication_failed.note: normative (no Python reference); the existing api/attest.go code

no_current_beat.message: evidence was posted before any beat was accepted for the principal

evidence_digest_unmatched.message: the report's canonical digest is not the report_digest of the principal's current beat

evidence_invalid.message: the report is not a valid heartbeat measurement report

authority_failed.note: normative (no Python reference); endpoint-neutral wording for a code several endpoints share, served in error.message; the per-endpoint registries keep Python's wording for their corpora

incarnation_unprovisioned.message: the incarnation is not registered with this service
